skills.description: AI-powered non-invasive rooting-stage detection for plant cuttings in transparent containers. skills.description: AI-powered indoor plant light stress detection from smart planter or fixed camera images (optionally combined with light sensor lux data). Detects morphological anomalies caused by low light (elongated internodes / etiolation, thin leaves, pale green color) or strong-light damage (leaf burn spots, scorched edges, curling, bleaching). Combined with optional lux sensor readings, it determines the current light stress type (insufficient / excessive / normal) and outputs adjustment suggestions (e.g. move to window, add shading, adjust grow-light duration).
